title.zh: FlashAttention 能把二次复杂度变成线性吗？
title.en: Can FlashAttention Turn Quadratic Attention into Linear Attention?

dek.zh: 把 GPU 内存 IO、精确 tiling、online softmax 与 sliding/sparse attention 的可见性取舍放到同一张账本。
dek.en: Account separately for GPU memory IO, exact tiling, online softmax, and the visibility sacrificed by sliding or sparse attention.

html.zh:
一个 128k-token 输入的 causal full attention，在单个 head 内就有约 82 亿个合法 query–key 配对。若天真地把每个分数存成 2-byte 数，光一层一个 head 的三角分数就约 16 GB，还没算 Q/K/V、其他 heads、MLP、KV cache 或临时缓冲。但并非所有实现真的把这张大矩阵写进 GPU 高带宽内存（HBM）。FlashAttention 的关键并不是少算了哪些 token 对，而是重新安排计算与数据搬运，避免物化完整分数和概率矩阵。

另一条路是真正减少可见边：sliding window 只让位置读取附近的过去，sparse/global 模式再选少量远程连接。它可能降低算术工作，但也改变模型能直接访问的证据。对 Agent，这个区别决定‘长上下文更快’到底意味着相同输入语义的更好实现，还是一项可能漏掉远处禁止条件的架构选择。

核心判断：FlashAttention 的 dense 模式是 IO-aware 的精确 attention，仍有二次 query–key 工作；sliding/sparse attention 改了连接图，才可能把边数降到近线性。速度、显存、可见性与任务正确率必须分别验收。
html.en:
A 128k-token causal full-attention input contains about 8.2 billion valid query–key pairs in one head. If each score were naively stored as a two-byte number, the triangular score array for that single head and layer would occupy roughly 16 GB, before Q, K, V, other heads, MLP activations, KV cache, or scratch buffers. This does not mean every real implementation materializes that array in high-bandwidth GPU memory, or HBM. FlashAttention's decisive move is not to drop token pairs; it reorganizes computation and data movement so the complete score and probability matrices need not be written to HBM.

A different route truly removes visibility edges. Sliding-window attention lets a position read only nearby predecessors. Sparse or global patterns add a limited set of longer-range links. These designs may reduce arithmetic work, but they also change which evidence a model can directly access. For an agent, the distinction determines whether 'faster long context' means a better execution of the same attention operation or an architecture that might omit a distant prohibition on an action.

Core judgment: dense FlashAttention is IO-aware exact attention and retains quadratic query–key work. Sliding or sparse attention changes the graph and can reduce edge count toward linear. Speed, memory, visibility, and task correctness require separate acceptance tests.

title.zh: 承接 RoPE、KV cache 与 Agent trace
title.en: Connecting RoPE, the KV cache, and agent traces

html.zh:
Long Context 1/3 已建立：RoPE 让直接 QK 点积含相对位移，但公式可在长索引求值，不保证模型能可靠使用长文本；位置插值改变相位分布；KV 复用还要绑定 position IDs、模型版本和 scaling。今天假设位置规则已经确定，专门打开算术与 GPU 内存层。不能把‘RoPE 扩窗’‘FlashAttention 加速’‘window attention 减边’混成一个功能开关。

9 月的 KV cache 一篇讲过 prefill/decode、连续 batching 和 paged KV。这里不重复那套服务入门：只需记住 prefill 要处理许多 query 位置，decode 往往一次只有少数新 query，故同一 attention kernel 在两阶段可能受不同瓶颈约束。FlashAttention 多讨论密集 attention 的矩阵块与 HBM IO；它不会自动消除 decode 的旧 KV 读取，也不决定请求该如何排队。

Agent trace 中要把四种变化分开标记：位置规则版本、attention kernel、连接图、服务调度。若线上切换后某条中段证据失效，可能是位置泛化、稀疏图缺边、证据组织、模型训练或 runtime 截断；只看最终 token/s 无法归因。相同 task、相同输入、相同模型权重下对比 kernel，才能评估执行实现；改变 sliding pattern 则已是模型语义实验。
html.en:
Part 1 established that RoPE puts relative offset into a direct QK dot product, yet evaluating the formula at a larger index does not guarantee effective use. Position interpolation changes the phase distribution. KV reuse also binds position IDs, model version, and scaling. Today hold the position rule fixed and open the arithmetic and GPU-memory layer. 'Extend with RoPE,' 'accelerate with FlashAttention,' and 'remove edges with window attention' are not one configuration knob.

The earlier KV-cache lesson covered prefill and decode, continuous batching, and paged KV. We do not repeat that serving primer. Keep only the distinction that prefill processes many query positions, whereas decode often has just one or a few new queries. The same attention kernel can therefore meet different hardware bottlenecks in the two phases. FlashAttention is primarily about blocks of dense attention and HBM traffic. It does not automatically remove reads of old KV during decode or decide how requests should be scheduled.

An agent trace should label four changes separately: position-rule version, attention kernel, connectivity pattern, and serving schedule. If a middle-of-context constraint stops influencing an answer after a rollout, the cause might be positional generalization, a missing sparse edge, input organization, training, or runtime truncation. A final tokens-per-second number cannot attribute the failure. Compare kernels under the same task, input, and model weights to test execution; changing a sliding pattern is already a model-semantics experiment.

title.zh: 机制：同一张图的分块，与另一张图的删边
title.en: Mechanism: tiles of the same graph versus removing graph edges

html.zh:
1. 先把‘二次’说清楚

长度 N、每个 head 维度 d 时，full causal attention 的合法 query–key 配对为约 N²/2，每对做长度 d 的点积，因此注意力分数算术约 O(N²d)。最简单的实现先写出 N×N 的 scores，softmax 后再写 probabilities，接着乘 V；这会产生二次大小的临时张量和 HBM 读写。真实库可能已融合部分步骤，不能把教科书实现当全部生产基线。无论如何，GPU 片上 SRAM 快而小，HBM 容量大但搬运昂贵；减少往返有时比减少少量 FLOPs 更重要。

2. FlashAttention 按 Q/K/V 块流式计算

为一小块 queries 读取 Q，再逐块读取可见的 K/V。每块产生局部分数，立即更新这些 query 的 softmax 归一化统计和 value 加权和；不把整张 attention 矩阵写回 HBM。每个 key block 用过后继续下一个，最后才写归一化输出。causal mask 仍在块内生效，不能偷偷让 token 看未来。训练反向传播也可保存少量归一化信息并重算局部块，而不是保存所有 N² 权重。这里的‘精确’指计算同一 dense softmax attention 公式，浮点运算顺序不同可有数值差异，不承诺 bit-for-bit 相同。

3. 为什么可以不存完整 softmax

softmax 的分母看似要先见过一整行分数。online softmax 维护当前最大值 m、指数和 l、未归一化 value 累加向量 a。新 block 若出现更大的最大值，把旧的 l 和 a 按新基准重新缩放，再加入该 block 的贡献；最终输出 a/l。这样可边读 K/V 边聚合，不用回头找完整 scores。数值稳定性来自减去运行中的最大值，而不是假装被省略的项为零。

4. FlashAttention-2 的优化仍不改连接

第一代 tiling 解决大量 HBM IO，但非矩阵乘的指令、线程块 occupancy 与 warp 间通信仍可限制吞吐。FlashAttention-2 的作者通过减少非 matmul 工作、重新分工与提高并行度报告进一步加速。这是论文在指定 GPU、shape 和基线上的结果；短序列、小 batch、decode 单 query 或不同硬件未必同等收益。若某 kernel 不支持当前 mask、head dimension、dtype 或设备，需要有行为等价的 fallback，并实测数值与性能。

5. Sliding window 真正改变谁看谁

若 query 仅能读取最近 w 个 key，合法边数约 Nw，w 固定时随 N 近线性增长。省下的不是只在 HBM 上的临时分数，而是原本许多 QK 点积根本不做。代价也真实：距当前很远的原文证据不在直接邻域。经过 L 层，信息可以通过层间中继向前传播，简单纯局部因果图的路径最多约 Lw 个 token；这不是模型必然保真传播的保证。Mistral 7B 论文报告滑动窗口配合 rolling KV 的实现，‘可处理任意长流’只说明机制可继续运行，不等于任意远事实仍可准确回忆。

6. 稀疏与 global token 是有价的桥

Longformer 结合局部窗口与任务指定的 global attention；BigBird 加入局部、随机和 global 连接。若全局 token 数为 g、每位置有 r 条额外连接，粗略边数为 O(N(w+g+r))。这些边可缩短远距离信息路径，但‘存在 global token’不意味着它学会把所有重要条款无损编码到那里。随机/稀疏边的理论性质与某个 Agent prompt 的可靠性不是同一命题。连接图还涉及硬件：不规则稀疏访问可能使理论 FLOP 节省无法转化为 wall-clock 加速。

7. 其他‘分块’不是同一层

chunked prefill 把一次长 prompt 的执行分成调度片，以免长 prefill 持续阻塞短请求；若保留完整模型状态和 attention 语义，它主要改变排队与延迟分布。把文档分块后各自总结、再把摘要交给模型，则已经改变输入证据与信息损失。跨 GPU 的 sequence parallelism 或 Ring Attention 把 blocks 分布到不同设备，还要承担通信与同步。与 FlashAttention tiling、稀疏删边分别记录，不要都叫‘用了 chunking’。

8. 服务端的第二张账本

即使 prefill 不物化 N² scores，full-attention decode 的新 query 仍须读取可见的旧 K/V。KV 驻留随层数、长度、KV heads 和精度增长；batch 多时可用显存先被 cache 占满。sliding layers 在其实现允许时可只留窗口内 KV；含 global/full layers 则不能把旧状态一概驱逐。运行时需按 prefill token、活跃 decode token、KV residency、请求 deadline 与风险做 admission 和调度。‘支持 128k’不能从单请求实验直接推导为高并发 SLA。
html.en:
1. State what is quadratic

For length N and head dimension d, causal full attention has roughly N²/2 valid query–key pairs. Each pair needs a length-d dot product, giving about O(N²d) score arithmetic. A simple implementation forms an N×N score array, writes probabilities after softmax, then multiplies by V. That creates quadratic temporary tensors and HBM traffic. Real libraries may already fuse some steps; a textbook implementation is not every production baseline. On-chip GPU SRAM is small but fast, while HBM is larger and expensive to traverse. Reducing trips between them can matter more than shaving a few floating-point operations.

2. FlashAttention streams blocks of Q, K, and V

Load a small block of queries, then stream visible K/V blocks through it. Each block creates local scores and immediately updates softmax normalization statistics and the value-weighted sum for those queries. The full attention matrix is never written to HBM. After a key block is consumed, move to the next; write normalized outputs at the end. The causal mask still operates inside blocks so no token reads the future. During training, the backward pass can retain small normalization summaries and recompute local blocks rather than storing N² attention weights. 'Exact' means the same dense softmax-attention operation is evaluated, subject to floating-point order and numerical differences; it does not promise bit-for-bit identical output.

3. Online softmax avoids storing the row

The softmax denominator appears to require every score in a row before any output can be finalized. An online calculation retains a running maximum m, sum of exponentials l, and unnormalized value accumulator a. If a new block contains a higher maximum, rescale the old l and a to the new reference before adding that block. The final output is a/l. A query can thus aggregate while K/V blocks stream by, without revisiting a stored score array. Subtracting the running maximum maintains numerical stability; this is not an approximation that sets omitted scores to zero.

4. FlashAttention-2 still preserves connectivity

First-generation tiling reduces HBM traffic, yet non-matrix-multiply instructions, thread-block occupancy, and communication between warps can still limit throughput. The authors of FlashAttention-2 report more speed from reducing non-matmul work and improving work partitioning and parallelism. Their figures describe particular GPUs, shapes, and baselines. Short sequences, small batches, single-query decode, and other hardware need not see the same gains. A serving kernel may also lack support for a mask, head dimension, dtype, or device. It needs a behaviorally equivalent fallback and numerical as well as performance tests.

5. A sliding window changes visibility

If a query reads only the latest w keys, the graph has about Nw edges, close to linear in N when w is fixed. This does not merely avoid writing temporary scores: many QK products are never computed. The trade-off is equally real. Source text far behind the current position is outside the direct neighborhood. Across L layers, information may relay forward through intermediate states; in a simple causal all-local graph the farthest possible path is roughly Lw tokens. A path's existence does not mean information is preserved faithfully. The Mistral 7B paper reports sliding-window attention and a rolling KV implementation. Its ability to continue processing a stream does not guarantee accurate recall of arbitrarily distant facts.

6. Sparse and global connections cost something

Longformer combines local windows with task-selected global attention. BigBird adds local, random, and global connections. With g global tokens and r extra connections per position, an illustrative edge count is O(N(w+g+r)). Global connections can shorten paths to distant information, but merely having a global token does not mean it learned to encode every important clause without loss. A theoretical property of a sparse graph is not a guarantee for an agent's prompt. Hardware matters too: irregular sparse reads can erase a theoretical FLOP advantage in wall-clock time.

7. Other meanings of 'chunk' belong to other layers

Chunked prefill divides execution of a long prompt into scheduling units so one request does not monopolize a server. If it preserves model state and attention semantics, it mainly changes queueing and latency distribution. Chunking a document, summarizing each piece, and submitting only the summaries is different: the model's evidence and information losses have changed. Sequence parallelism or Ring Attention distributes blocks across GPUs, introducing communication and synchronization. Record these separately from FlashAttention tiling and from sparse edge removal instead of calling every one of them 'chunking.'

8. Keep a second serving ledger

Even if prefill avoids materializing N² scores, a new query during full-attention decode still reads visible historical K/V. KV residency rises with layer count, sequence length, KV heads, and precision; under batching, cache may exhaust device memory first. Sliding layers can sometimes evict KV older than their window, depending on implementation. Global or full-attention layers cannot discard all old state that way. Admission and scheduling need budgets for prefill tokens, active decode tokens, KV residency, deadlines, and risk. Supporting 128k in one request does not establish a high-concurrency service-level objective.

title.zh: 必要数学：online softmax 与可见边预算
title.en: Essential mathematics: online softmax and an edge budget

html.zh:
full causal attention 的合法边数为 E_full=N(N+1)/2，N 是 token 数。每条边的 QK 点积约 d 次乘加，故工作量量级 O(N²d)。最直观的分数数组需 O(N²) 元素；FlashAttention 避免将其完整物化到 HBM，但不删去 E_full 条边。这里的内存节省特指 attention 中间分数/概率的存储和搬运，不能宣称整个模型、KV 或参数内存变成常数。

对一行 query，令旧 block 的运行最大值、指数和、value 累加向量为 m、l、a。新 block 分数 sⱼ 与 value vⱼ 到来时，令 m′=max(m,maxⱼsⱼ)，再更新 l′=e^(m−m′)l+Σⱼe^(sⱼ−m′) 和 a′=e^(m−m′)a+Σⱼe^(sⱼ−m′)vⱼ，最终 o=a/l。m′ 是稳定指数的基准，旧项的缩放使前后 blocks 可合并；a 是向量，l 是标量。被 causal mask 遮住的 sⱼ 不加入和。数值会受浮点舍入影响，但目标仍是同一个 softmax。

若 sliding window 保留最近 w 个 key，每层约 E_window≈Nw 条边；额外 g 个全局、r 个稀疏连接则约 O(N(w+g+r))。此式只数连接，不含稀疏索引、缓存与 kernel 启动成本。纯局部 L 层的最大路径跨度约 Lw，表示‘可能传到’，不表示远处证据一定被无损保留。
html.en:
Full causal attention has E_full=N(N+1)/2 legal edges for N tokens. Each QK dot product performs work proportional to head dimension d, giving O(N²d) score arithmetic. A straightforward score array uses O(N²) elements. FlashAttention avoids materializing it in HBM but does not remove the E_full edges. This memory saving concerns intermediate attention scores and probabilities; it does not make entire model, KV, or parameter memory constant.

For one query row, let running maximum m, exponential sum l, and value accumulator a summarize earlier blocks. A new block contains scores sⱼ and values vⱼ. Set m′=max(m,maxⱼsⱼ); then update l′=e^(m−m′)l+Σⱼe^(sⱼ−m′) and a′=e^(m−m′)a+Σⱼe^(sⱼ−m′)vⱼ, finishing with o=a/l. The new maximum is a stable reference. Rescaling old terms makes blocks composable. The accumulator a is a vector and l a scalar. Scores hidden by the causal mask contribute nothing. Floating-point rounding may differ, but the target remains the same softmax operation.

If a sliding window retains w recent keys, each layer has roughly E_window≈Nw edges. Adding g global and r sparse connections per position gives an illustrative O(N(w+g+r)). The formula counts connections, not indexing, cache management, or kernel-launch costs. In L purely local layers, the farthest possible relay path spans roughly Lw positions. 'Can reach' is not 'will retain distant evidence faithfully.'

title.zh: 对 Agent 系统的影响

html.zh:
能力：精确 tiling 可让同一 full-attention 模型更高效处理长 tool output，不改变理论上可直接读取哪些位置；sliding/sparse 可换取更长可服务序列，却要把远证据路径作为架构限制明确暴露。模型仍可能在 dense 可见时忽略证据，不能把可见性当正确率。

可靠性：切换 kernel 应在固定权重、位置规则、输入与 mask 下做数值/任务回归；切换连接图需要重新训练或至少评测，因为模型看到的依赖图已变。Agent 的‘禁止发布’等硬约束不能只指望被局部层从万 token 外传来，应放在 runtime typed state 与授权门里。

性能：把 TTFT、inter-token latency、HBM 读写、KV residency、OOM/admission、吞吐和尾延迟分开。FlashAttention 可能改进 prefill 却不解决长 decode 的 KV 带宽；稀疏 FLOP 少也可能因为低效 kernel 得不到实际加速。
html.en:
Capability: exact tiling can run the same full-attention model more efficiently on long tool output without changing which positions are directly readable. Sliding or sparse attention can trade visibility for a longer serviceable sequence; the distant-evidence path must be an explicit architectural limit. Dense visibility still does not guarantee correct use.

Reliability: when swapping kernels, keep weights, position rule, input, and mask fixed for numerical and task regressions. Changing the connectivity graph requires renewed training or, at minimum, evaluation because the model's dependencies changed. Hard agent constraints such as a prohibition on deployment should not rely on a local layer relaying a sentence from thousands of tokens ago. Keep them in typed runtime state and an authorization gate.

Performance: separate time to first token, inter-token latency, HBM traffic, KV residency, out-of-memory admission, throughput, and tail latency. FlashAttention may improve prefill without solving KV bandwidth during long decode. Fewer sparse FLOPs may still fail to improve wall-clock time if the kernel is inefficient.

html.zh:
• ‘FlashAttention 是线性 attention’：dense 模式不删 QK 边；线性的是某些中间内存需求，不是二次算术。
  • ‘exact 就 bitwise 一致’：浮点归约顺序和精度不同；用容差及下游任务回归，不要求逐 bit 相同。
  • ‘sparse 边少就一定快’：不规则访存、索引与低 occupancy 会吞掉 FLOP 优势；测真实硬件与批量。
  • ‘滑窗看不到远文就完全不能用’：多层、global token 或额外检索可建间接路径；但路径不保证内容保真。
  • ‘global token 自动记住全文’：全局汇聚要靠训练学会，重要否定词仍可能丢失；做位置与冲突测试。
  • ‘chunked prefill 等于摘要分块’：前者通常是调度切片，后者改变信息；trace 中要记录不同类型。
  • ‘单请求 128k 即高并发 128k’：KV、queue 和显存预算随活跃请求叠加；做 admission 与尾延迟验收。
html.en:
• 'FlashAttention is linear attention': dense mode does not delete QK edges. Some intermediate-memory needs fall toward linear, not quadratic arithmetic.
  • 'Exact means bitwise identical': floating-point reduction order and precision can differ. Use tolerances and downstream regressions rather than demanding identical bits.
  • 'Fewer sparse edges must run faster': irregular memory access, indexing, and low occupancy can consume a FLOP advantage. Benchmark real hardware and batches.
  • 'A window cannot use any distant content': layers, global tokens, or retrieval can create indirect paths, but a path does not guarantee faithful preservation.
  • 'A global token remembers everything': global aggregation must be learned; a decisive negation may still be lost. Test placement and conflicts.
  • 'Chunked prefill is summary chunking': one usually slices execution scheduling; the other changes information. Trace them distinctly.
  • 'One 128k request proves a high-concurrency 128k service': KV, queue, and memory budgets add across active requests. Validate admission and tail latency.

html.zh:
• 区分 token 配对数、HBM IO 与 KV 驻留；它们是不同的成本账本。
  • FlashAttention 对同一 dense attention 做分块与 online softmax，省搬运和中间矩阵，不删合法边。
  • sliding/sparse 删边可近线性扩长，但远证据的直接可见性与模型语义改变。
  • ‘可达’不等于‘保真’，global token 和跨层中继都须按任务实测。
  • Agent 的授权/未决状态外置；对 kernel 与连接图分别做性能和正确性验收。
html.en:
• Count token-pair arithmetic, HBM IO, and KV residency separately.
  • FlashAttention tiles the same dense attention and uses online softmax, saving transfers and intermediate matrices without removing legal edges.
  • Sliding or sparse graphs can grow near-linearly in edges but change direct visibility and model semantics.
  • Reachability is not fidelity; test global-token and cross-layer relay on the actual task.
  • Keep agent authorization and unresolved effects outside the context; validate kernels and graph changes with different gates.

html.zh:
• FlashAttention — 作者提出 IO-aware 精确 tiling，论文中的加速是指定硬件/基线的作者报告；其 block-sparse 扩展另属近似/删边模式。
  • FlashAttention-2 — 作者分析并优化分工、occupancy 与非 matmul 工作，结果不自动适用于所有 shape。
  • Online normalizer calculation for softmax — 流式稳定归一化的原始方法论文。
  • Longformer — 作者提出局部窗口加任务指定 global attention；该论文主要研究 encoder/encoder-decoder 场景。
  • Big Bird — 作者提出局部、随机、全局稀疏边并报告理论与任务实验；理论性质不等于 Agent 保真保证。
  • Mistral 7B — 作者报告 sliding-window attention 与 rolling KV 的模型实现。
  • Ring Attention — 作者报告跨设备 blockwise attention；通信/硬件收益依其环境。

四类变更账本、Agent 硬约束外置与按能力/资源/质量拆分验收，是本文在论文机制之上的工程分析，不是上述作者共同验证的通用生产架构。
html.en:
• FlashAttention — the authors propose IO-aware exact tiling. Reported speedups depend on their hardware and baselines; its block-sparse extension is a separate approximate or edge-removing mode.
  • FlashAttention-2 — the authors analyze work partition, occupancy, and non-matmul operations. Results do not automatically cover every shape.
  • Online normalizer calculation for softmax — the original method paper for streaming stable normalization.
  • Longformer — the authors combine local windows and task-selected global attention, largely in encoder and encoder-decoder settings.
  • Big Bird — the authors propose local, random, and global sparse edges and report theoretical and task results; those properties do not guarantee agent fidelity.
  • Mistral 7B — the authors report a model implementation using sliding-window attention and rolling KV.
  • Ring Attention — the authors report distributed blockwise attention; communication and hardware gains depend on their setting.

The four-change ledger, externalized agent hard constraints, and separate capability, resource, and quality gates are engineering analysis built on these mechanisms, not a universally validated production architecture.

html.zh:
已建立：1/3 的 RoPE 相位和位置索引决定 attention 如何理解距离；今天又将同一 dense 图的 FlashAttention tiling 与改变连接图的 sliding/sparse 分开。前者省 HBM 往返与临时矩阵，后者删 QK 边并承担远证据路径风险。长窗口还受 decode KV、batch admission 和调度约束。

尚未讲完：即使位置和服务机制允许长输入，模型能否把中段证据、冲突来源与时间约束可靠用于答案和动作？该用什么测试区分 needle 命中、引用正确、跨文档综合与业务后置条件？

下一篇起点：Long Context Internals 3/3 将把前两篇合成有效上下文评测与 Agent context 决策：位置切片、干扰与冲突、长短回归、检索/摘要/直接输入的选择、成本与终态证据。
html.en:
Established: Part 1 showed how RoPE phase and position IDs give attention distance structure. Today we separated FlashAttention tiling of the same dense graph from sliding or sparse changes to that graph. Tiling reduces HBM traffic and intermediate matrices; edge removal creates distant-evidence path risks. Decode KV, batch admission, and scheduling still constrain long windows.

Unresolved: even when position and serving mechanisms admit long input, can the model reliably use middle evidence, conflicting sources, and temporal constraints in its answer or action? Which tests distinguish a needle hit from accurate citation, multi-document synthesis, and a verified business outcome?

Next: Long Context Internals Part 3/3 synthesizes effective-context evaluation and agent context decisions: position slices, distractors and conflicts, long and short regressions, choosing retrieval, summaries, or direct input, cost, and terminal evidence.

zh: RoPE 位置结构与 FlashAttention 执行优化是不同层次
dense FlashAttention 保留全 QK 边并以 online softmax 省 HBM IO
sliding/sparse 删边近线性扩长但改变远证据的直接可见性
长窗口服务还受 KV 驻留、batch admission 与调度约束
en: RoPE positional structure and FlashAttention execution optimization are different layers
Dense FlashAttention retains all QK edges while online softmax reduces HBM IO
Sliding and sparse patterns remove edges and distant direct visibility while scaling closer to linearly
Long-window service remains constrained by KV residency, batch admission, and scheduling
